speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Malrotation with Volvulus. The combination of bilious vomiting, feeding intolerance, and the absence of abdominal distension in a newborn within the first 24 hours of life is highly suggestive of this surgical emergency, which can be fatal if not addressed immediately.
